game: Marvel's Spider-Man 2 (PC, launcher v1.130.1.0, toc SHA-1 318f4345f3a1)

tools.name: ALERT dat1lib (Tkachov/ALERT, GPLv3)
tools.version: commit bc90ed9b53fbcaa3b7acf94b36f00e77eab0dacb, obtained separately (not bundled), located through SM2_ALERT
tools.role: toc reading (dat1lib.read, toc2 sections, archive extraction) and the crc32 / crc64 name hashes; imported on first use, not needed by the installer, the .stage codec or the .actor codec

tools.name: Overstrike (Tkachov/Overstrike)
tools.role: alternative installer for the released .stage; sm2_install.py reproduces its MetaInstaller_I29 + StageInstaller_I29_V2 behaviour without it

tools.name: Spider-Man 2 kit scripts (scripts/)
tools.role: i30 toc / DAT1 / .model / .texture / .material / .actor read-write, .stage read-write and installer, name index and extraction, VRM fit, batch builder for every suit and outfit model, facial rig transfer, AnimDynamics chains, cat-prop and head-actor physics carriers, offline readbacks

runtime_boundary: Game launcher v1.130.1.0 (toc SHA-1 318f4345f3a1), mods installed as d\mods\mod<i> with toc.BAK. v1 (static all suits + cat-backpack physics) and v2 (head-actor carrier physics on all 91 masked suits) were confirmed in game by the user; both were built with the original scripts. The portable copies were checked offline only (2026-10-14, same game build and VRM): the installer reproduces the v2 install / uninstall toc hashes, the index / extract / actor / dynamics round trips and the offline readbacks of the v2 release give the same output as the original scripts, and reduced builds (one target model; plain, --dyn, --dyn --face; cat prop; head carrier for one suit) are asset-for-asset identical apart from the empty default author (see VALIDATION.md). The full v1 / v2 builds were not rerun with the kit.
python: 3.10+ (standard library) for the installer, index / find / extract and the .actor codec; the fit, builders and checks need numpy 2.5 (3.12+), Pillow, scipy and etcpak; tested 3.14.0
dependency_install: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt -r portable-kits/marvels-spider-man-2/requirements.txt (from bundle root); ALERT: git clone https://github.com/Tkachov/ALERT, check out bc90ed9b53fbcaa3b7acf94b36f00e77eab0dacb outside the repository and set SM2_ALERT to it
